import unittest

from solution import normalize_origin_policy


class NormalizeOriginPolicyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(normalize_origin_policy([]), ())
        self.assertEqual(normalize_origin_policy((), True), ())

    def test_normalize_deduplicate_order_and_ports(self):
        origins = [
            " HTTPS://Example.COM:443/ ",
            "https://example.com",
            "http://EXAMPLE.com:80/",
            "http://example.com:8080",
            "https://example.com:8443/",
        ]
        original = list(origins)
        self.assertEqual(
            normalize_origin_policy(origins),
            ("https://example.com", "http://example.com", "http://example.com:8080", "https://example.com:8443"),
        )
        self.assertEqual(origins, original)

    def test_ipv6_and_port_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            normalize_origin_policy(("http://[2001:DB8::1]:80", "https://[2001:db8::2]:65535/", "http://host:1")),
            ("http://[2001:db8::1]", "https://[2001:db8::2]:65535", "http://host:1"),
        )

    def test_wildcard_rules(self):
        self.assertEqual(normalize_origin_policy([" * "]), ("*",))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            normalize_origin_policy(["*", "https://example.com"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            normalize_origin_policy(["*"], allow_credentials=True)

    def test_type_errors(self):
        for origins in (None, "https://example.com", {"https://example.com"}):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                normalize_origin_policy(origins)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            normalize_origin_policy([1])
        for value in (0, 1, None, "yes"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                normalize_origin_policy([], value)

    def test_rejects_malformed_or_unsafe_origins(self):
        invalid = (
            "",
            "   ",
            "ftp://example.com",
            "example.com",
            "http://",
            "http://user@example.com",
            "http://user:pass@example.com",
            "http://example.com/path",
            "http://example.com?x=1",
            "http://example.com/#fragment",
            "http://example.com:notaport",
            "http://example.com:65536",
            "http://[not-ipv6]",
        )
        for origin in invalid:
            with self.subTest(origin=origin):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    normalize_origin_policy([origin])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
